title: The rep is read-only once invoiced; non-reps can't be picked
custom_preconds:
1. A customer to sell to exists; if none does, create one first: Customers -> New Customer (e.g. "4 Star Truck Repair").
  2. An invoiced or paid part sale. Seed it: create a part sale as above, receive its parts so it reaches Complete, then click Create Invoice.
  3. A staff member who is NOT marked as a sales representative exists (Settings -> Staff).
custom_steps:
1. On the invoiced or paid sale, try to change the Sales Representative field and confirm the captured attribution.
  2. On an open sale, open the Sales Representative picker and look for the non-rep staff member.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • On an invoiced or paid sale the Sales Representative field is read-only and the attribution captured at invoicing does not change.
  • A staff member not marked as a sales representative does not appear in the picker and cannot be selected.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667 (Founder Mode Batch #1); story SV-10266 (Attribute a part sale to a sales representative); Part Sales Update v1 PRD (Confluence 867434569), Story 5; design canvas boards S5_*; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-N3: “Once the sale is invoiced or paid the field is read-only, and the attribution captured at invoicing does not change afterwards”
  • S5-N4: “A staff member who is not marked as a sales representative cannot be selected”
